title: Experimentally Extending Quantum Kernel Learning to Quantum Data by NMR
abstract: arXiv:2412.09557v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum kernel learning (QKL) promises efficient machine learning by encoding feature maps onto exponentially large Hilbert spaces inherent in quantum systems. Using the liquid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) platform, we implement and benchmark QKL for one-dimensional regression and two-dimensional classification tasks. We then classify entangling and non-entangling operators by extending QKL to handle parametrized or non-parameterized operator inputs. We first compute the kernel numerically for a double-layered star system and then experimentally validate it on a 3-qubit NMR register. QKL provides a practical route to compare operators on native quantum hardware without expensive tomography protocols. translated_title: 实验性地通过核磁共振将量子核学习扩展到量子数据
translated_abstract: 量子核学习（QKL）通过将特征映射编码到量子系统固有的指数级大希尔伯特空间中，有望实现高效的机器学习。利用液态核磁共振（NMR）平台，我们实现并基准测试了QKL在一维回归和二维分类任务中的表现。随后，通过扩展QKL以处理参数化或非参数化算子输入，我们对纠缠和非纠缠算子进行分类。我们首先对双层星系统进行数值计算核，然后在3量子比特NMR寄存器上进行实验验证。QKL提供了一种实用途径，无需昂贵的层析成像协议即可在原生量子硬件上比较算子。我们的结果证实了QKL在处理量子数据方面优于其他经典方法，从而突显了其捕获量子空间固有结构并扩展其操作领域的能力。
tldr: 本研究通过核磁共振平台实验验证了量子核学习在量子数据分类中的优越性，无需层析成像即可高效处理量子算子。
en_tdlr: This study experimentally validates the superiority of quantum kernel learning for quantum data classification on an NMR platform, enabling efficient operator comparison without tomography.
